name: Feng Tay Enterprises Co., Ltd.
summary: Feng Tay Enterprises Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells athletic shoes in Singapore, the United States, Mainland China, Switzerland, Mexico, and internationally. The company provides casual shoes, ice skates, ski boots, golf balls, soccer balls, backpacks, ice hockey helmets and clubs, shoe parts, shoe molds, and tools.
